case_title: DANIEL YANG VS. DAVID T. NGUYEN

docket_entries.description: DISMISSAL OF ENTIRE ACTION OF ALL PARTIES AND ALL CAUSES OF ACTION WITH PREJUDICE CLAIM HEARING OF MAY-23-2018 OFF CALENDAR, DISMISSAL FILED
FILE DESTROYED PER ORDER SIGNED BY JUDGE SAMUEL FENG ON 12/9/2021 PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 681.53.
AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,351.00 FILED BY YANG, DANIEL AS TO DEFENDANT NGUYEN, DAVID T. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-02-2018 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-02-2018 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO APR-06-2018 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506 PLAINTIFF DANIEL YANG IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT DAVID T. NGUYEN IS PRESENT. NO PROOF OF SERVICE. DEFENDANT COULD NOT UNDERSTAND PROCESS OF SERVICE WHEN ASKED IF HE WOULD WAIVE OR RETAIN HIS RIGHT TO SERVICE, THEREFORE CONTINUING THE MATTER FOR PROOF OF SERVICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CECILIA P. CASTELLANOS; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. 506
ORDER RE: CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)
DECLARATION OF NON-SERVICE & REQUEST FOR RESET OF COURT DATE. FILED BY PLAINTIFF YANG, DANIEL
TRIAL RESET TO MAY-23-2018 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506 TRIAL OF APR-06-2018 IS TAKEN OFF CALENDAR
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $40.00 SERVED MAR-30-2018, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT NGUYEN, DAVID T.
